xgboost_passing_v5_integrated.name: xgboost_passing_v5_integrated
xgboost_passing_v5_integrated.author: NFL Analytics Team
xgboost_passing_v5_integrated.description: XGBoost v5 integrated model with OC+DC coaching features. Includes 114 features: player aggregations from 3 Bayesian models, enhanced travel features, causal features (DID roughing, PSM travel/weather), OC continuity features, and DC features. Trained on 2020-2024 data. WARNING: Contains data leakage - same-game features (attempts, completions, TDs) used during training are not available at inference time. Low MAE (3.74) is artificially inflated. REQUIRES RETRAINING without leaky features before production use.

dc_features_module.name: dc_features_module
dc_features_module.author: NFL Analytics Team
dc_features_module.description: Defensive Coordinator (DC) feature generator. Extracts DC continuity, scheme familiarity, blitz frequency, and zone coverage ratio features. Complements OC features for complete coaching staff modeling. Uses rolling 4-game windows with exponential decay (H=4).

oc_features_module.name: oc_features_module
oc_features_module.author: NFL Analytics Team
oc_features_module.description: Offensive Coordinator (OC) feature generator (updated). Extracts OC continuity, games with OC, tenure seasons, and new OC adjustment. Integrated into XGBoost v5 training pipeline alongside DC features. Uses rolling 4-game windows with exponential decay (H=4).

ensemble_v6_dirichlet_weights.name: ensemble_v6_dirichlet_weights
ensemble_v6_dirichlet_weights.author: NFL Analytics Team
ensemble_v6_dirichlet_weights.description: Ensemble v6.3 with XGBoost v4 Ridge DISABLED due to target leakage. Configuration: State-Space v2 (35%), Hierarchical v2 (35%), XGBoost v4 Ridge (0% - DISABLED), Informative Priors v2 (15%), Hybrid Static-Incremental (15%). Leakage discovered Dec 17, 2025: residual_feature (actual - pred) was used as input, giving 91.4% feature importance.
ensemble_v6_dirichlet_weights.notes: XGBoost v4 Ridge disabled Dec 17, 2025 due to target leakage. Fix script available.

fourth_down_cql_grid.name: fourth_down_cql_grid
fourth_down_cql_grid.author: NFL Analytics Team
fourth_down_cql_grid.description: Fourth down decision CQL agent grid search (Nov 26, 2025). Hyperparameter optimization across 20 trials. Trained on fourth_down_dataset_train.csv (2018-2023). Grid search directory: models/fourth_down_grid_20251126_112610/

game_feature_extractor.name: game_feature_extractor
game_feature_extractor.author: NFL Analytics Team
game_feature_extractor.description: Game-level feature extraction module. Aggregates player-level projections from Bayesian models (state-space, hierarchical, informative priors) to game-level team features. Computes mean, std, Gini, depth ratio, percentiles, and top-player concentration metrics.

team_defensive_features.name: team_defensive_features
team_defensive_features.author: NFL Analytics Team
team_defensive_features.description: Team defensive feature generator. Extracts pass defense efficiency, run defense efficiency, pressure rate, coverage quality, and situational metrics. Uses rolling windows with exponential decay.

team_offensive_features.name: team_offensive_features
team_offensive_features.author: NFL Analytics Team
team_offensive_features.description: Team offensive feature generator. Extracts pass offense efficiency, run offense efficiency, red zone efficiency, third down efficiency, and tempo metrics. Uses rolling windows with exponential decay.

bayesian_state_space_v2.name: bayesian_state_space_v2
bayesian_state_space_v2.author: NFL Analytics Team
bayesian_state_space_v2.description: State-Space v2 Bayesian model for passing yards prediction. Dynamic player skill estimation with random walk priors. Uses cmdstanr with 10 MCMC chains (Mac M4 optimized). Training window: 2018-2024 with H=4 exponential decay. Ensemble weight: 27% (highest individual component).

bayesian_hierarchical_v2.name: bayesian_hierarchical_v2
bayesian_hierarchical_v2.author: NFL Analytics Team
bayesian_hierarchical_v2.description: Hierarchical v2 Bayesian model for passing yards prediction. Multi-level model with player, team, and position effects. Uses brms with 10 MCMC chains (Mac M4 optimized). Training window: 2018-2024 with H=4 exponential decay. Ensemble weight: 27% (tied for highest).

bayesian_informative_priors_v2.name: bayesian_informative_priors_v2
bayesian_informative_priors_v2.author: NFL Analytics Team
bayesian_informative_priors_v2.description: Informative Priors v2 Bayesian model for passing yards prediction. Bayesian regression with domain-informed priors on player/team effects. Uses brms with 10 MCMC chains (Mac M4 optimized). Training window: 2018-2024 with H=4 exponential decay. Ensemble weight: 13% (lowest but still valuable for diversity).

bnn_rushing_v3_1.name: bnn_rushing_v3_1
bnn_rushing_v3_1.author: NFL Analytics Team
bnn_rushing_v3_1.description: Bayesian Neural Network v3.1 for rushing yards prediction. Only production BNN model (BNN passing research abandoned after 84 hrs). Uses PyMC with variational inference. Calibrated to 89.5%. Note: Not used in ensemble v6 (focused on passing yards).

ab_test_infrastructure_v1.name: ab_test_infrastructure_v1
ab_test_infrastructure_v1.author: NFL Analytics Team
ab_test_infrastructure_v1.description: A/B Test Infrastructure for v6.0 vs v6.1 Dirichlet weights experiment. Includes: ABTestMonitor (guardrails, statistical testing, SPRT), DirichletABTestRouter (MD5 hashing, deterministic assignment), database tables (ml.ab_test_results, ml.ab_test_status, ml.ab_test_guardrail_violations, ml.ab_test_significance), and config management. Designed for 4-week validation of Dirichlet weights for player props.

game_outcome_model.name: game_outcome_model
game_outcome_model.author: Claude Code
game_outcome_model.description: Fixed GameOutcomeModel with temporal split, computed uncertainties, and batch extraction. Trained on 2022-2024 data (652 games) with 3 XGBoost models (spread, total, win_prob).

game_outcome_model_v2.name: game_outcome_model_v2
game_outcome_model_v2.author: Claude Code
game_outcome_model_v2.description: Game Outcome Model v2 with 382 features including 38 semantic LLM-derived features. Trained on 2022-2024 data. A/B test vs v1 showed +4.6% win accuracy improvement with semantic features. SHAP analysis shows sem_away_media_buzz_volume in top 50 features. Promoted to production Dec 23, 2025.

xgboost_v4_ridge_residuals_validation.name: xgboost_v4_ridge_residuals_validation
xgboost_v4_ridge_residuals_validation.author: Claude Code
xgboost_v4_ridge_residuals_validation.description: DEFINITIVE VALIDATION of XGBoost v4 Ridge Residuals after fixing target leakage. The original 4.27 MAE was entirely fake - residual_feature (actual - ridge_pred) was used as input, allowing model to memorize answers. FIXED model removes residual from input; XGBoost predicts residuals from player features only. RESULT: Fixed MAE = 59.14 yards, 47% WORSE than 40.20 baseline. Ridge R²=0.006 shows opponent features explain almost nothing. CONCLUSION: XGBoost v4 Ridge should remain permanently DISABLED.
xgboost_v4_ridge_residuals_validation.notes: Decision gate MAE < 38 FAILED. Do not re-enable without fundamentally different approach.
